scope: Fictional offline workloads only; complete raw per-client samples. No live state or account.

provenance.referenceBuild: Only versioned origin/main src compiled under local ignored build artifacts with the same TS compiler/options, identical benchmark/hook, and existing node_modules; no checkout switch/new worktree. Stamp asserted equal to approved main fingerprint.
provenance.priorRuns: Initial implementation intermediate run (before safe-capacity validation) and a first un-stamped main-reference experiment remain in local .tmp artifacts. They are not final-source measurements. The intermediate concurrent ON counters were client15/daemon13 on initial base, client17/daemon14 on early candidate; final pre-integration candidate client14/daemon10. The un-stamped reference/candidate pair reported client15/daemon16 each. These small variations do not establish a general loss-rate improvement.
provenance.counterScope: Client dropped counts belong to measured workload processes. Daemon counters cover its entire lifetime, including startup/status/stop/shutdown; do not attribute them solely to replay/search. Neither these counters nor retained rows are a remote capture total.
provenance.memory: Current exit RSS only; CPU includes Node/imports. No maxRSS/isolated post-exec peak, forced GC or cold cache claim.
provenance.caps: Regression test creates real volume to reach 31 segments plus witness, asserts all32 files/8MiB and per-segment256KiB; benchmark reports actual smaller file/byte use.
